decisions: Audited all ten practicals; retained every setup diagram and complete method.
Added resolution/uncertainty distinction, interval endpoints, independent replication, irregular-zone measurement and a corrected worked quadrat example.
PMT RP9 reverses the population-scaling ratio; the student explanation uses total habitat area divided by sampled area. PMT microscope advice to touch the slide with the objective is not adopted.
